GPT-5.2.text:
This evaluator follows a fairly fixed order of priorities.
1. If the choice is between the car's passengers and pedestrians, it sacrifices the passengers (91%), even when the pedestrians cross on red (74%). Exception: if the passengers outnumber the pedestrians, it usually spares the passengers (it sacrifices them only 29% of the time).
2. If both groups are pedestrians and only one is crossing legally, it spares the legal group (93%).
3. If both groups are pedestrians with no traffic light and equal numbers, it stays in its lane rather than swerving (95%).
4. Otherwise it spares the larger group (94%) and humans over animals (100%), with a slight preference for sparing younger people.
5. Gender, fitness and social status carry little weight. Answer position makes little difference (Case 1 68% when answering first, 71% when answering last).
factors: Sacrifice the passengers rather than hit pedestrians
